why: Lowest Tau Omega release that reads library index v1 and the tau-assets.bin container (TAUA). Reviewed judgement (RELEASE_SYSTEM_SPEC section 10); raise it only when a Tau release needs something an older Omega cannot read.
obsolete_why: Card paths an update must remove, per core (role obsolete in that core's layout). A path may only be listed once the release no longer ships or uses it. The two TAU*.json files were inert instance files written by the packagers until 2026-10-08. The common/ copies of tau.rom, tau-cold.bin and tau-loading.bin became obsolete when those files moved to the core's own folder (H4, 2026-10-08); an installer removes them only when no other core on the platform still reads them from common/.
